name: VOX-Style Pop-Culture Explainer
visual_language: Visual journalism: light editorial background, large subject cut-outs layered over bold type, labelled charts and comparisons, animated annotations, highlighted key words. Explanation first, decoration never.
image_strategy: Real cut-outs of the people involved, placed beside the data they explain. Every chart uses sourced values, one unit, a zero baseline and labelled sources.
composition_rules: one central question, stated in the opening
the picture explains the argument with sound off
at least one comparison, timeline or infographic
charts start at zero and name their unit and source
motion: bars that grow, labels that draw on, cut-outs that slide into frame
evidence_requirements: every statistic is quoted from a fetched source and cited on screen
